name: Disk Space Indicator
description: Shows total, used and free space for the filesystem volume visible to Jellyfin and adds a library scan shortcut to the server drawer.
overview: See server disk usage from Jellyfin.

versions.changelog: Updated the library-scan route for Admin Enhancements.

name: Admin Enhancements
description: Synchronizes Jellyfin movie and series deletions with matching Seerr requests and Radarr/Sonarr media files.
overview: Reduce manual cleanup after deleting media from Jellyfin.

versions.changelog: Renamed to Admin Enhancements and updated its Jellyfin routes.

name: Audio Delay
description: Adjusts audio timing in the Jellyfin web player and can lock a per-track delay for an entire series season.
overview: Fix audio that is ahead of or behind the picture.

versions.changelog: Initial release with per-track audio delay and season locks.
